## Screener pad X storage

**SoT:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/data/projects.json`  
**Type:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/lib/projects.ts` (infers from seed)

| Field | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `x` | Pad/org X URL (`https://x.com/...`) |
| `ecosystem.x` | Parent brand X (StonkOptions only → `stardotfun`) |
| `sources[].url` | Often duplicates the X URL |
| `devX` / `devGithub` | Founder/dev slots — **all currently `null`** |
| `contact` | Relationship status (`"unknown"`), **not** a handle |

**Founder handles in screener JSON: no.** Every project has `"devX": null`. UI can render `devX` (`app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx`) but nothing is filled.

## Current `/api/feed` rank

**File:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/site-data.ts` → `filterFeed`

1. Drop deleted / noise / retail spam  
2. Ecosystem lane: keep only `ECOSYSTEM_FEED_BUCKETS` (`/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/buckets.ts` L258–268):  
   `builder_integrating_sdk`, `scaffold_forker`, `pad_migrating_or_exploring`, `vertical_quote_meta`, `pad_live_on_dbc`, `pad_ecosystem_drama`, `hackathon_builder`, `ecosystem_integration`, `competitor_pain`  
3. Exclude official lane accounts  
4. **Sort: newest first only** — `mentionTimestamp(b) - mentionTimestamp(a)` (L131)  
No pad boost; no leadScore on the feed (leadScore is leaderboard-only).

---

## Smallest ranking change (pad accounts → DBC builders → rest)

In `filterFeed`, replace the single timestamp sort with a 3-tier comparator (reuse existing Set; no new handle list):

```ts
import { SCREENER_PAD_HANDLES } from "./ecosystem-anchor.js";

const DBC_BUILDER_BUCKETS = new Set<BucketId>([
  "builder_integrating_sdk",
  "scaffold_forker",
  "pad_migrating_or_exploring",
  "vertical_quote_meta",
  "pad_live_on_dbc",
  "hackathon_builder",
  "ecosystem_integration",
]);

function authorHandle(m: MentionRecord) {
  return (m.author?.username ?? "").toLowerCase();
}

// after filters:
.sort((a, b) => {
  const aPad = SCREENER_PAD_HANDLES.has(authorHandle(a));
  const bPad = SCREENER_PAD_HANDLES.has(authorHandle(b));
  if (aPad !== bPad) return aPad ? -1 : 1;

  const aB = DBC_BUILDER_BUCKETS.has(a.classification.primary);
  const bB = DBC_BUILDER_BUCKETS.has(b.classification.primary);
  if (aB !== bB) return aB ? -1 : 1;

  return mentionTimestamp(b).getTime() - mentionTimestamp(a).getTime();
});
```

That leaves drama/competitor posts in the feed but below builders; pad **account** posts win regardless of bucket. Tests to extend: `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/test/site-data.test.ts`.
